name: td-transfer-pricing
description: Prepare Chad transfer pricing working papers for 2026 for foreign related-party dealings and indirect profit transfers. Covers control and transaction mapping, functions, assets and risks, selection and explanation of an arm’s-length method, purchase and sale profit adjustments, the turnover-or-assets documentation threshold, general group and entity-specific support, DSF attachment and information-request periods. Use for Chad related-party services, intercompany purchases, royalties, head-office allocations, pricing documentation or the 500 million FCFA threshold. Two cases recompute adjustments and distinguish the documentation boundary from substantive pricing. Administration templates, APA and CbCR implementation, treaty relief and some penalty interpretation remain explicit gaps; this is a partial preparation method.
